final.title: Final challenge: the cycle
final.instr: number the steps in the right order.
rows: The control unit decodes the instruction
The PC is incremented to point to the next instruction
The instruction is fetched from RAM into the MDR
The address is copied into the MAR
The PC holds the address of the next instruction
